model.scope: Source cue boundaries, hold-source lifetime, focus and delayed-entry cancellation

skip.scope: Original native warrior video, session-only roster, callbacks and rendering; no OS input claim
checks: PASS story fixture never uses normal user roster storage
PASS successful creation starts story once with selected identity
PASS story owns creation deletion and entry input
PASS original warrior video decodes in native Player
PASS original first caption follows native video time
PASS next follows original cue and epsilon
PASS short hold does not skip
PASS release cancels skip progress
PASS focus loss clears held sources
PASS completed hold enters loading gate before gameplay
PASS story completion enters gameplay with created name
PASS natural or skip marks session seen; playback failure does not
PASS story completion does not create another slot
PASS subsequent creation starts its own story
PASS lobby return cancels stale story entry without losing identities
